2019 Q2.gq: Our capital spending guidance is unchanged at a range of $725 million to $810 million.
2019 Q2.bq: Though we achieved record daily production levels this quarter, we felt short of our expectations.

2021 Q2.gq: However, our capital guidance range is unchanged.
